text:
Maddie: Short sprint today: finalize hero line for landing (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), two social posts, and the webinar RSVP routing. Need everything live by tomorrow AM.

Asha (Content): Draft hero options: 
- 'One API. Any deployment. Predictable outcomes.'
- 'Ship LLM features with confidence and control.'
- 'Consistent inference across hosted, reserved, and private.'

Luis (Designer): I prefer the short one: 'Ship LLM features with confidence and control.' Clean art ready for that.

Ravi (Growth): Social posts: benchmark-led and product story. Short drafts: 
1) 'Benchmark: 2x lower cost, 30% faster median latency vs our baseline. Live demo + methodology in our webinar. [link]'
2) 'How we shipped a recommender in 2 sprints — same API across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. See the migration playbook in our webinar. [link]'

Noah (Sales): RSVP form must capture deployment_interest + company_size + compliance_needs. If deployment_interest in (Dedicated, Private) AND company_size >= 250 -> tag enterprise and route to SDRs. Add checkbox 'Request private walkthrough'.

Ivy (Webdev): Will add fields and wire Segment.track('webinar_rsvp'). ETA 3 hours. Will debounce client events per ops-bot.

ops-bot: Event ingestion cap: 300 req/min. Recommend 2s debounce and server dedupe.

Maddie: CTA choices: primary 'See live demo', secondary 'Get migration checklist'. Enterprise CTA 'Request private walkthrough' -> Noah. Any objections?

Asha (Content): I'll finalize microcopy and 2 social variants. Luis, can you export hero assets once we lock the line?

Luis (Designer): On it. Will export updated artboards when you confirm the H1.

Ravi (Growth): Add UTM params: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=tri_launch_4300. Also schedule posts: launch day + reminder day before webinar.

Noah (Sales): I'll draft SDR triage doc and priority scoring (compliance + size). Sharing by EOD.

Maddie: Decision: going with 'Ship LLM features with confidence and control.' Primary CTA 'See live demo'. Ivy, ping when Segment test event is live.

Ivy (Webdev): Test event pushed to staging now. Please check analytics.

Maddie: Thanks team. I'll finalize the schedule and do a quick preflight at 10:30. :rocket:
